Positions of the Sun, Moon and planets come from the Swiss Ephemeris (2.10), running on this phone. The zodiac is sidereal with the Lahiri (Chitrapaksha) ayanamsa; Rahu is the mean node and Ketu is opposite it.

A day runs from sunrise to the next sunrise at your city (upper limb of the Sun, standard refraction). Tithi, nakshatram, yogam and karanam end times are found to the second. Months are amanta (new moon to new moon); a month with no sankranti is adhika.

Rahu kalam, Yamagandam and Gulika split the daytime into eight parts; Durmuhurtham into fifteen; Varjyam and Amrita kalam follow each nakshatram's ghati table. Every table, with its source, is in the app's data files.

Marriage matching adds the eight kootas (36 points), then looks at Rajju, Vedha and Kuja dosha — from lagna only when both birth times are known. A names-only match uses the nama nakshatram and is always marked approximate.

Muhurtham windows leave out Rahu kalam, Yamagandam, Gulika, Varjyam and Durmuhurtham, apply the month rules (adhika, Chaturmasam, Dhanurmasam, moudhyami of Guru and Shukra for vivaham) and each person's tarabalam and chandrabalam.
Job: Vimshottari dasha and the transits of Guru, Shani and Rahu from your janma rasi. Income & expense: the Ugadi year's aadayam-vyayam table for your rasi, added each Ugadi.
